# Tip: 以人工方式設定x軸刻度顯示之內容

# Title: adjust x-axis labels
# Date: 2012/7/29
x <- seq(-0.9, 0.9, by = 0.1)
y <- rnorm(19)
plot(x, y, pch=15, cex=1, type="b", ylim=c(0.0,100), xlim=c(-0.9,0.9), axes=F)
axis(1, at=x, labels=x)
axis(2, ylim=c(0.0,100))
box()
# end

parts: # TRY!!! x軸刻度為0 時沒有顯示, 一般較少採用此方法.
# Title: adjust x-axis labels

x <- seq(-0.9, 0.9, by = 0.1)
y <- rnorm(19)

plot(x, y, pch=15, cex=1, type="b", ylim=c(-3,3), axes=F)
xlabels <- as.character(x)
xlabels[10] <- ""
axis(1, at=x, labels=xlabels)
axis(2)

box()
# end
